Subject: Request for senior authorization — Hosted API rate concession for NovaCloud

Team,

Summary: NovaCloud (YC-backed infra SaaS) is asking for a sustained 25% off our list Hosted API usage rate in exchange for a 12-month committed consumption agreement and co-marketing (marketplace listing + case study). They project 12M tokens/month in Q1 ramping to 24M tokens/month by Q3. Total expected billings under the proposed concession are ~ $210k over 12 months (vs $280k at list).

Why this ask:
- Competitive urgency: a competitor is bundling embedding credits with storage; losing NovaCloud would block a strategic partner placement.
- Upside: marketplace distribution and potential dedicated deployment in H2 2027.
- Risk: concession >20% — beyond deal desk signoff thresholds.

Request: senior authorization for a one-time 25% rate concession on Hosted API usage for the initial 12-month committed term. Preconditions we propose if approved: 1) signed SOW with monthly minimums, 2) explicit termination/reversion clause if usage <50% of forecast for 2 consecutive months, 3) Redwood reference + marketplace listing commitment.

Attachments: redwood_proposal_v3.pdf (terms + pricing), novacloud_mau_forecast.xlsx (MAU/token curve), srd-soc2-summary.pdf (security summary requested by NovaCloud).

Next steps: can I get :thumbs_up: or a counter? If yes, I will send the concession letter and updated DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ben

Irene / Mina / Ben — reviewed the ask and numbers. I approve a 25% concession on Hosted API usage pricing under the following conditions:

1) 12-month committed term with a monthly minimum (MAU/token floor) to be included in the SOW.
2) Reversion clause: if actual usage is <50% of forecast for two consecutive months after month 3, pricing reverts to list rates retroactive to month 1 of the contract.
3) Redwood receives explicit permission for a marketplace listing and a short joint case study within 6 months of go-live.
4) Discounts limited to Hosted API (no credits for Dedicated/Private).

Marissa — please prepare the amendment language and a one-page approval memo. Irene — once you confirm SOW minimum language, Ben can send the concession letter to NovaCloud. After DocuSign is initiated, loop legal for a quick review.
